question: What happens when rajas and tamas dominate at the time of death?
premises: Dominance of rajas and tamas leads to a different departure than sattva.
Such a person goes deluded into a karmic birth.
The dying state is marked by sensory confusion and labored breathing.
inference: When rajas and tamas prevail, death leads to deluded karmic rebirth accompanied by confusion and distress.
plain_english: If one dissolves in rajas and tamas, one goes deluded into a karmic birth; then there is confusion of the senses and distress marked by labored breathing.
